changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate dataset entries and normalized dataset names. All tasks are correctly identified as the paper evaluates on six NLP tasks including sentiment analysis, translation, question answering, summarization, text generation, and dialogue response.

Removed all automatic metrics as the paper does not explicitly mention using any specific automatic evaluation metrics. The evaluation focuses on training efficiency and computation FLOPs rather than output quality assessment.
No LLMs are used as judges in this paper. The paper focuses on improving Mixture-of-Experts model training efficiency, not on evaluating generated outputs using LLM judges.
No human evaluations are conducted in this paper. The evaluation is focused on computational efficiency and training time reduction rather than output quality assessment.

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on improving training efficiency of Mixture-of-Experts models through adaptive gating mechanisms. While it evaluates on NLG tasks, the evaluation metrics are computational (training time, FLOPs) rather than output quality metrics. The paper does not conduct human evaluations or use LLMs as judges.
